notes: External Windows cp311 environment: Torch 2.7/cu128, NumPy 1.26.4, exact flash/PyG/spconv wheels in unirig/uv.lock. Keep PTv3 standard attention and 17.4 GiB admission floor. PyOpenGL's prebuilt universal piwheels wheel has 2131 Python files matching the official 3.1.0 sdist (SHA 9b47c5c3a094fa518ca88aeed35ae75834d53e4285512c61879f67a48c94ddaf), no native/DLL payload; retain its complete notice. Unused OmegaConf/wandb are omitted. The sidecar supplies its own architecture facts from MIT fairseq/UniRig plus Apache Transformers defaults; no restricted Meta OPT config, weights or tokenizer are downloaded for the local1 version.
